description: Detect circular import dependencies. Pass the project SOURCE ROOT as a directory for a full scan (scan is capped at depth 5 below rootPath, node_modules excluded — the response discloses the scanned scope, and hasCircularDeps:false only covers that scope). Returns each cycle with its file path and a fix recommendation. To show cycles visually afterwards: open_visualizer + visualize_batch with highlight (red, pulse) steps.

rootPath.description: Path to scan - can be a single file or a directory. If a directory, scans all .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx files.

name: detect_circular_deps
